original_test_intent: Validate each applicable E1.S sensor's identity, description and reading in SDR and Sensor views through verified in-band and out-of-band paths against the approved platform specification.
original_method: Obtain the missing approved Sensor-List commands and map the E1.S device topology to canonical sensor records; collect complete protected SDR and Sensor outputs through same-target IB/OOB paths; normalize and compare identity, entity, reading, unit, status, thresholds and freshness against SPEC while preserving all logs.
manual_activity: The owner/vendor supplies the missing Sensor-List procedure, E1.S topology, canonical mapping, SPEC and absent-state rules; the operator reviews unresolved resources and sets the final verdict.
safety_requirements: Do not invent the missing Sensor-List method
Never change thresholds, events, fans or device state
Do not clear SEL or OS logs
Do not truncate output before completeness validation
Never retry automatically to conceal stale or divergent readings
agent_execution_scope: Collect complete SDR and Sensor views on both paths
Compare normalized fields against SPEC and absent rules
Archive no-mutation evidence and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Supply topology, canonical mapping and SPEC

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It invents a literal sensor name, truncates the SDR list, uses insecure SSH and leaves the source's missing IB/OOB Sensor-List phase uncovered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After owner approval of the missing steps, use protected complete `sdr elist` and `sensor list` collection through both verified paths and compare canonical E1.S records against the versioned SPEC.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The existing E1.S SDR commands, dual-view criteria and 10/10-minute envelope are preserved; the blank procedure is explicitly gated instead of silently inferred.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a per-slot matrix with device identity, expected SDR/entity record, live Sensor record, IB/OOB fields, freshness and explicit absent-state result, referencing the approved completion of the source procedure.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Closes the blank Sensor-List phase, anchors filters to physical topology and retains complete evidence rather than grepped fragments.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: SDR-only evidence cannot prove the required live reading/status surface, and a text match cannot prove all expected E1.S slots are covered.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Firmware may expose E1.S resources under vendor labels; those aliases require an approved mapping rather than automatic substring expansion.

project_override_considerations: The Project must publish the missing IB/OOB Sensor-List commands and define the E1.S record set before execution. Row 1661's M.2/NVMe mapping and row 1663's hot-plug/FAN ambiguity are distinct and cannot fill this gap.
expected_evidence: Target identity, firmware, E1.S topology and SPEC version
Complete redacted SDR and Sensor output from IB/OOB
Per-slot four-way SPEC comparison with freshness/absent analysis

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items and criteria consistently target E1.S sensor validation. The empty Sensor-List step is missing required method detail, not a competing objective; it is preserved and gated for owner completion.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The missing commands, topology, mapping and SPEC are obtainable project inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if the approved Sensor-List method or normative mapping cannot be supplied.

review_improvement: Makes the omitted half of the source procedure visible and mandatory, preventing SDR-only evidence or an invented sensor name from passing both stated criteria.
independent_technical_reasoning: SDR records describe sensor metadata and may remain present even when a device is absent or a live reading is unavailable; `sensor list` exposes a different operational view. Since the source explicitly requires both, equality cannot be inferred from one surface. The approved completion must also preserve path symmetry so IB and OOB cannot accidentally query different repositories.
